courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 大直徑鑽掘豎井
related.transfer: 可遷移「節理楔塊的機理與驗證」與「交叉口開口率的機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大直徑鑽掘豎井的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Joint wedge mechanism and verification" and "Intersection opening ratio mechanism and verification" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦岩洞穹頂的節理楔塊、岩拱與複合支護；大直徑鑽掘豎井則以大直徑豎井的切削、出碴與支護產能平衡為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cavern-crown joint wedges, rock arching and composite support; Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation centres on balancing cutting, muck removal and support in large shafts, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「節理楔塊」與「開挖斷面」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大直徑鑽掘豎井，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「通風流量的機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Joint wedge” and “Excavation section”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ventilation flow mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 地下岩洞穹頂支護
history.text: 大跨度岩洞的穩定同時受到節理幾何、開挖卸載、支護剛度及三維交叉口影響。本課分開討論可脫落楔塊與整體岩體拱效應，讓學徒用力學模型、應變監測及反算辨別真正的荷載路徑，再檢查地震與排水退化如何改變既有支護的需求。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1997年：美國陸軍工兵署發布岩石隧道與豎井工程手冊，建立公開工程參考；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2018年：香港發布岩洞工程指南第二版，整理岩洞規劃設計及施工實務。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Large-span cavern stability depends on joints, excavation unloading, support stiffness and three-dimensional intersections. This course distinguishes detachable wedges from rock-mass arching, uses force models, strain monitoring and back-analysis to identify load paths, and evaluates how seismic action and drainage deterioration change support demand. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1997: USACE publishes its rock-tunnel and shaft manual as a public engineering reference; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2018: CEDD publishes the second cavern-engineering guide covering planning, design and construction. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
